[[File:Wakaba HZ020.png|thumb|250px|Wakaba]] '''Wakaba''' (Japanese: '''ワカバ''' ''Wakaba'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[HZ020|Kabu's Battle Training!]]''. She is a {{tc|Gym Trainer}} apprentice, shadowing under [[Kabu]]. ==History== Wakaba encountered [[Liko]] and [[Roy]] outside [[Motostoke Stadium]] and took them inside to see Kabu. She later watched as they took on the Gym Test, which Roy eventually won. Being a novice {{pkmn|Trainer}} herself, Wakaba was awestruck by Liko's methods of extinguishing {{p|Litwick}}'s flames with {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}}'s {{m|Leafage}}. Wakaba subsequently joined Kabu in a [[Multi Battle|Tag Battle]] against Roy and Liko. Once Kabu's {{p|Centiskorch}} had defeated [[Roy's Fuecoco]], Kabu left the rest of the battle to Wakaba telling her this would count as her Gym Leader test. However, she was not confident with her battle style, due to being inexperienced, which caused her {{p|Rolycoly}} to receive [[damage]]. Determined to win, she resolved to do her best. Hearing this from Wakaba, Liko felt bad for her and forfeited. Unfortunately, this did not make Wakaba happy as she did not want to become a Gym Trainer without truly earning it, leading Wakaba to run off. After being spoken to by Kabu, Liko went to find her, and they both apologized to each other for how they had acted. Feeling better now, Wakaba gave Liko encouragement to do her best in the future. She reappeared in a flashback in ''[[HZ021|The Lonely Hatenna]]''. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Wakaba |pkmn=Rolycoly |type1=Rock |img=Wakaba Rolycoly.png |epnum=HZ020 |epname=Kabu's Battle Training! |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Rolycoly}} is Wakaba's only known Pokémon. It was used to battle [[Liko]] and her {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}}, only for Liko to not want to battle and forfeit.
